javascriptRequired: Enable JavaScript to use the interactive product catalog.

toolsPage.browser_workflow: The workshop can be completed entirely in the browser on Windows and Mac. Use [Fault injection](http://localhost:8089) to create the problem and [Fallbacks & timeouts](http://localhost:8089/#mitigations) to change the shop's response.
toolsPage.optional_commands_help: You do not need to type any of the commands below. The console's **Info & commands** tab also shows the last request with a Windows/Mac selector.
toolsPage.what_changes_when_i_enable_a_fallback: What changes when I enable fallback and its circuit breaker?
toolsPage.fallback_behavior: Inventory fallback returns **Stock unconfirmed** if stock cannot be checked. Shipping fallback obtains a real quote from a backup carrier at the same shipping price with a longer delivery time. If both providers fail, it shows **Shipping quote unavailable**. A short timeout bounds dependency waiting and releases shared workers. Enabling the separate circuit breaker pauses failed calls for five seconds before one recovery probe. The fallback preserves the complete catalog with honest partial information. These settings apply immediately.
toolsPage.restore_defaults_help: Restore defaults in **Fallbacks & timeouts**, then clear the fault in **Fault injection**. Your answers remain saved. Runtime settings last until Storefront restarts and reloads its startup configuration.
toolsPage.implementation_help: Fault requests change the real **Toxiproxy** paths. Mitigation requests change the Storefront's live timeout and fallback policies through an internal Docker listener. No Docker socket or host shell is exposed to the console.
